The '''Laakteen Depot system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Laakteen Depot]] and the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Laakteen/Legends|Laakteen]].
